canonical_rules: row_id is required and must be unique
family is required and must be explicit
status is required and must be one of PASS_SHAPE_ONLY, OPEN_GAP, FAIL_BLOCKER, NOT_RUN
row_universe_digest is computed from sorted row_id values with LF separators
visualization JSON is derived local data, not a second source of truth
bad rows must be classified rather than silently dropped
all THOS row-universe artifacts keep gmut_gate_effect as none_open_not_tested
